how_built.detail: Four counts taken by the position calculator at 23:59 on 30 Sep
Every rule change read between 1 Jul and 30 Sep, with its state
Every gap accepted by the CCO, with owner and expiry
Sections drafted from the records above; every number links to its record
Elena Petrova prepared; Anthony Marsh approves

conclusions: Coverage improved: 1,704 of 1,892 obligations covered, up 82 in the quarter.
Obligations with nothing behind them fell from 55 to 45.
Two changes need board attention: phishing-resistant MFA (due 1 Dec) and the Reg E 5 day credit (due 4 Jan).
Nine known gaps are open; the wire release gap expires 31 Dec.
